v1.1.8Split.description: Upper eye flap meshes split so the broad flap plate rotates about the open/close servo pinion while the inter-servo arm, open/close servo and remaining carrier hardware stay on the tilt link.

v1.1.9Split.description: Upper-flap split corrected: each flap-mounted HS-85 servo body and mounting bracket now reside in the rotating flap mesh. The Servo Arm/rod/collars and its two HX-SHCS retainers remain in the tilt-carrier mesh and do not inherit open/close rotation.
carrierIncludes: Servo Arm assembly (rod + two servo collars/horn interfaces)
